subject: Client success handshake: roadmap, owners & accountable dates
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Grant <olivia@tideworks.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 25 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Client success handshake: roadmap, owners & accountable dates

Hi Olivia —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Per request, attached is a concise Mutual Action Plan (MAP) draft and an initial implementation timeline. I captured the milestones we discussed and aligned owners across CS and Implementation. Please review and confirm by EOD Wednesday so we can lock the Sprint 0 dates.

Summary (high-level):
- Milestone 1 — Kickoff + Environment Prep: target 2026-06-01 to 2026-06-07 — Owner: TideWorks infra (Olivia) / Redwood provisioning (Ben)
- Milestone 2 — Early Integration (API keys, VPC peering, sample calls): 2026-06-08 to 2026-06-22 — Owner: TideWorks dev lead (TBD) / Redwood integration (Monica)
- Milestone 3 — End-to-end validation & security sign-off (SOC evidence, retention policy): 2026-06-23 to 2026-07-06 — Owner: TideWorks security / Redwood security (Marissa)
- Milestone 4 — Pilot traffic + performance baseline: 2026-07-07 to 2026-07-21 — Owner: TideWorks product / Redwood CS (Ben)

Open asks for you:
1) Confirm TideWorks owners for Milestones 1–3 (names + emails).
2) Confirm the team can commit to the target Kickoff week (w/c 2026-06-01). If not, propose alternate kickoff windows.
3) Share any procurement or legal hold-ups that could block Milestone 3 sign-off.

Attachments: tideworks_map_v1.pdf (MAP with milestones & acceptance criteria), access_matrix.xlsx (proposed accounts/roles).

If you prefer, we can do a short 20-minute alignment on Wednesday to finalize.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

---
Attachment(s): tideworks_map_v1.pdf (11 pages)
From: Olivia Grant <olivia@tideworks.com>

Date: Mon, 25 May 2026 09:45:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Client success handshake: roadmap, owners & accountable dates

Thanks Ben — this looks sensible and is a helpful starting point. A few notes from our side:

- Kickoff week: we have a product offsite the week of 2026-06-01; could we shift kickoff to 2026-06-08 (one week later)?
- TideWorks owners:
  - Infra: Olivia Grant (olivia@tideworks.com) — I'll own Milestone 1
  - Dev lead: Marco Villanueva (marco.v@tideworks.com) — suggested for Milestone 2
  - Security: Anika Shah (anika.shah@tideworks.com) — Milestone 3 sign-off
- Procurement: minor paperwork pending; legal expects to finalize the SOW by 2026-06-10. That could compress Milestone 3 if not handled concurrently.

I propose: shift every milestone +7 days to accommodate our offsite and procurement, but keep the same durations. Can you confirm Redwood availability for the new window?

Olivia
Director, Implementation
TideWorks

Thanks — shifting +7 days is doable from our side. Proposed updated dates below (keeps durations identical):

- Milestone 1 — Kickoff + Environment Prep: 2026-06-08 to 2026-06-14 — Owner: Olivia Grant (TideWorks) / Ben Carter (Redwood)
- Milestone 2 — Early Integration: 2026-06-15 to 2026-06-29 — Owner: Marco Villanueva (TideWorks) / Monica Patel (Redwood)
- Milestone 3 — End-to-end validation & security sign-off: 2026-06-30 to 2026-07-13 — Owner: Anika Shah (TideWorks) / Marissa Cole (Redwood)
- Milestone 4 — Pilot traffic + performance baseline: 2026-07-14 to 2026-07-28 — Owner: TideWorks product / Redwood CS (Ben)

Key risks I flagged internally:
- Procurement completing after 2026-06-10 could compress Milestone 3. Recommend TideWorks provide security pre-reqs (access list, retention policy) by Kickoff to parallelize work.
- VPC peering lead time: Monica will open tickets with infra teams on Day 1; please ensure Marco's team can accept our test CIDR the first week.

I attached the access_matrix.xlsx with suggested account roles and who needs API keys vs. console access. Monica — can you confirm Redwood infra slots for June 8–14 and any blackout windows?

Ben
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
